title: Kacey Musgraves, Eric Church, ‘Landman’ & More to Be Saluted at 2026 ACM Honors: Full List
summary: Carly Pearce will host the event for the sixth year, this time alongside Parker McCollum.
contentText:
Kacey Musgraves , Eric Church , Bill Anderson and the Paramount+ TV series Landman are among those to be saluted at the 19th Academy of Country Music Honors, which is set for Wednesday, Aug. 19, at The Pinnacle in Nashville.

Behind-the-scenes industry players who will be honored include Leslie Fram , Mike Curb and Scott Zolke. C2C: Country to Country, Europe’s biggest country music festival, will be honored. Two awards will be presented posthumously — to the legendary The Carter Family and to songwriter Brett James.

Four-time ACM Award winner Carly Pearce will return for the sixth year as the event’s host, this time alongside three-time ACM Award winner Parker McCollum , who is cohosting for the first time. Performers and presenters will be announced in the coming weeks.

Previously announced ACM artist-songwriter of the year winner Ella Langley , ACM songwriter of the year winner Jessie Jo Dillon , as well as ACM Studio Recording Award and Industry Award winners, will be feted at the event.

Here’s a full list of the honorees at the 2026 ACM Honors.
